page: OVHcloud t2-90 is a dual-accelerator cloud server within the Cloud GPU family, engineered for deep learning workloads and parallel computing. The system is driven by an Intel Xeon 6226R processor operating at 2.9 GHz with 30 dedicated physical x86_64 cores and no hyperthreading. Memory capacity is configured at 90 GB of RAM, providing 3 GB per CPU core. Hardware acceleration is provided by two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs offering a combined 64 GB of HBM2 VRAM. Local storage features an 800 GB NVMe SSD, accompanied by a 4 Gbps baseline network interface.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel compute capabilities driven by the dual V100S accelerators and dedicated CPU allocation. In standard host processor evaluations such as Geekbench and PassMark, single-core and multi-core integer, ray tracing, and compilation benchmarks fall into the average range. Multi-threaded decompression through bzip3 reaches 233.64 GB/sec, placing in the top quartile. However, large-block uncached memory write bandwidth is lower at 24.29 GB/sec. In AI workloads, the dual V100S configuration delivers top-tier throughput in language model inference, achieving 1,423 tokens per second on 7B parameter prompt processing and 152 tokens per second on 70B parameter models.

The t2-90 balances dedicated non-hyperthreaded CPU execution with high-bandwidth accelerator memory, avoiding virtualization contention for compute cores. Primary hardware tradeoffs include the legacy Volta GPU architecture compared to newer generations and moderate host memory write performance. The local 800 GB NVMe SSD provides fast temporary storage for model weights, datasets, and cache files. This configuration is best suited for deep learning inference, model fine-tuning, computer vision analysis, and scientific computing pipelines.
description: OVHcloud t2-90 is a dual-GPU instance in the Cloud GPU series tailored for accelerated parallel workloads. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6226R processor with 30 dedicated physical x86_64 cores running at 2.9 GHz, it includes 90 GB of system RAM, an 800 GB NVMe SSD, and 4 Gbps baseline network throughput. Compute capability is centered around two NVIDIA Volta V100S GPUs supplying 64 GB of total VRAM. While synthetic CPU benchmarks and uncached host write memory bandwidth rank in the average and lower quartiles respectively, the instance demonstrates top-tier efficiency in large language model inference and dense tensor tasks, processing 7B model prompts at 1,423 tokens per second. The combination of dedicated non-hyperthreaded cores and high-bandwidth GPU memory offers an effective hardware density for parallel tasks. OVHcloud t2-90 is suited for machine learning inference, model fine-tuning, ray tracing, computer vision, and scientific data processing pipelines.
